authority: Navigation map of PART 0's ownership procedure; not a replacement parser or a conformance profile.

phases.title: Block structure decision order
phases.constraint: Each line runs S1 to S5 once, in order and without backtracking; T applies at each boundary.

phases.title: S1 Payload
phases.constraint: An open fence tests its closer first. Comments are classified before S3, and remain ordinary lines for ownership.

phases.title: S2 Owner
phases.constraint: Walk frames outside in; the owner is the deepest frame whose content column the line reaches. A lone `+` reaches only a marker column.

phases.title: S3 Form
phases.constraint: Classify in the owner's coordinates. An opener past the content column opens in the owner and its lines move left by its indentation, at every level.

phases.title: S4 Lazy
phases.constraint: A line that missed a frame folds into the deepest open paragraph unless its form interrupts. One test at every depth and in every family; a fold closes nothing.

phases.title: S5 Apply
phases.constraint: Otherwise close every missed frame and apply the form in the owner. A closed block leaves no open paragraph.

phases.title: T Apply the transition
phases.constraint: Container survival and paragraph openness are separate facts, set by the boundary the line formed.

evidence.projection: Reviewed HTML bytes; these fixtures do not prove invisible AST ownership or arbitrary-depth equivalence.
